newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ericsson says unaware procedures overlooked.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says unaware procedures overlooked.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications firm LM Ericsson said on Thursday that it had no information that any procedures regarding a tender awarded to it by Telekom Malaysia Bhd had been overlooked.
Ericsson said in a statement issued in Kuala Lumpur that it had also not been officially informed or received any indication as to the nature of the alleged irregularities.

On Wednesday, Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said he had received a report that there may have been "discrepancies" in a contract awarded by state-owned telecommunications firm Telekom to Ericsson.
Telekom said on Thursday that it was making a thorough inquiry into the allegations.
Ericsson said it wished to reaffirm its commitment to "maintaining a high standard of business ethics."
"This has always been maintained in our long relationship with Telekom Malaysia, as well as with all other customers," the statement said.
Ericsson has been providing telecommunications infrastructure and facilities in Malaysia since 1965, it said.
